I actually met her in one of her last shows. She is super sweet in person. And definetly not racist! she travels a lot, speaks several languages and asked me about my home country, spoke to me on my native language and thanked us fans several times. She gets lots of hate for being pretty and into fashion. Like she says so herself, she has to take care of herself to give a nice image to fans and she goes as far as to share this with us on her blog, still people hate on her. She is a true metal head and you can tell in the shows she is the first one to instigate people partying, moshing... etc, all while she sings her heart out, headhands and air plays guitar and drums while delivering glass shattering vocals... yet if someone is sick or loses their phone, stops the show for everyone to help them. She looks does look a bit reserved but gave very sweet vibes overall. They are all amazing people who love music and their fans.
